text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar or fast food. Second, exercise regularly, for example by walking, swimming, or playing sports, because it keeps your heart strong. Third, make sure you get enough sleep, about seven to eight hours each night, so you feel energetic. Mental health is just as important, so talk to friends, relax, and ask for help when you feel stressed. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance, with time for both work and rest. These simple habits can make you happier and healthier.
